text:
owen: Strange one — I ran `redwoodctl login` and browser flow finished, but my localserve instance keeps showing me as the old demo user. I can see two different tokens in my home dir. Anyone seen XDG/legacy config confusion?

rachel: can you paste `ls -la ~/.config/redwood ~/.redwood` and `cat ~/.config/redwood/auth.cache | head -n1` (or redact) ?

owen: sure — output:```
$ ls -la ~/.config/redwood ~/.redwood
-rw-r--r-- 1 owen staff  230 Mar 22 16:10 /Users/owen/.config/redwood/config.yaml
-rw------- 1 owen staff 1024 Mar 22 16:10 /Users/owen/.config/redwood/auth.cache
drwxr-xr-x 2 owen staff   64 Feb 10 09:01 /Users/owen/.redwood
-rw-r--r-- 1 owen staff  198 Feb 10 09:01 /Users/owen/.redwood/config.yaml
-rw------- 1 owen staff 1024 Feb 10 09:01 /Users/owen/.redwood/auth.cache
```
`cat ~/.config/redwood/config.yaml` shows profile: `owen-personal`
`cat ~/.redwood/config.yaml` shows profile: `demo-company`

marta: ah — this is the XDG vs legacy path split. older redwoodctl wrote to ~/.redwood, newer respects XDG_CONFIG_HOME and writes to ~/.config/redwood. localserve currently prefers the legacy path if it exists (we left that fallback for compat) so it kept using the old demo profile/token.

owen: so the browser login updated ~/.config/redwood/auth.cache but localserve read ~/.redwood/auth.cache and kept the demo token. That explains the mismatch.

rachel: quick fixes: (1) remove or rename ~/.redwood (if you don't need it), or (2) copy/migrate the token and config into XDG dir: `mkdir -p ~/.config/redwood && cp ~/.redwood/* ~/.config/redwood/` then restart localserve.

owen: copied files over and restarted localserve — now it shows my personal profile. Thanks. But this will confuse new users.

marta: agreed. Action items: (a) add a migration step in redwoodctl on first run that detects legacy ~/.redwood and offers to migrate or merge profiles, (b) update localserve to prefer XDG by default and only fallback with a clear warning message, (c) add a quick note in the upgrade guide about XDG vs legacy config conflict. I'll open a ticket.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-762: "config migration: detect and migrate legacy ~/.redwood to XDG (~/.config/redwood)"

devex-bot: Created issue #4722: "localserve should prefer XDG_CONFIG_HOME and warn when legacy ~/.redwood exists" and added labels: devexp, migration, low-risk

owen: happy to test a migration PR if someone wants a repro. I can keep both copies for now and share exact diffs.

rachel: also logging note for docs team: add a troubleshooting bullet about "duplicate config directories" in quickstart.

owen: marking my onboarding snag as resolved. Thanks team!
